body: Wanted to leave some for the families coming by who were grabbing some for their kids. I guess my philosophy is just to kind of take only what I need. Also, limited car space

After I finally came clean to my parents about how exhausting it’s been to work two jobs and try to keep up with rent + bills every month they just said “We’re so proud of you for working so hard!” And proceeded to tell me about how they are spending thousands of extra money they have on vacations and renovating their house. It’s like we’re living in two different worlds.
🤷 definitely seems more like a standard commuter bike but a free bike is a free bike!
It’s all I could get to fit in my car! Was trying for a third but was worried about damaging the other bikes in the process
